scope: Ten concept proposals, each in English and English–Myanmar hybrid language treatment for September–December 2026 planning.

concepts.title: The Last Good Bite

concepts.window: 26–31 December · year-end CRM and retail reactivation
concepts.sponsorship: Retail loyalty, payment or delivery-partner contribution proposed; commercial terms TBC

sources.title: Myanmar Economic Monitor, June 2026: Shock Amid Fragility
sources.supports: 2026 macro pressure: weak demand, fuel/logistics costs, inflation and operating uncertainty.

sources.title: Digital 2026: Myanmar
sources.supports: Late-2025 digital planning indicators: 39.8m internet users, 62.5m mobile connections and 21.0m social identities.

sources.title: Holiday List of 2026 — Consulate General of Myanmar, Los Angeles
sources.supports: Public dates used in this planning calendar: 26–27 Oct Thadingyut, 23–24 Nov Tazaungdaing, 4 Dec National Day; client must confirm local operating calendars.

sources.title: Local delicacies take centre stage at Taste of the Golden Land 2026
sources.supports: Evidence of a Yangon food festival format that combines regional cuisines, brand participation, activity programmes and photo moments.

sources.title: City Mall Myanmar — Food category catalogue
sources.supports: Myanmar-language retail context and publicly visible food brands/products, including City Selection, Yummy, Popy, Pa Pa, Feel and Penguin.

sources.title: 2026 Agriculture Related Trade Shows and Conferences — USDA FAS
sources.supports: Publicly indexed 2026 food-and-beverage/retail-show opportunity; exact venue, dates and sponsorship inventory require organiser confirmation.

sources.title: Myanmar Advertising Costs 2026: Facebook, Google, TikTok Rate Card
sources.supports: Indicative platform planning ranges that are expressly proxy-based where Myanmar platform data is unavailable.

sources.title: Yoma Bank — Currency Exchange Rates
sources.supports: Dated planning USD/MMK reference: MMK 3,658 per USD for trade-related transactions; not a binding supplier or settlement rate.
